prerequisites: Successful completion of the modules to be completed according to the study plan in the 1st and 2nd academic semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know central questions, analysis perspectives, and methods of vocational education research, they know the different sub-areas of the vocational education system, they know the specific institutional and organizational structures and the conditions for their development, and they recognize phenomena of change.
Students can analyze the vocational education system based on criteria and distinguish pedagogical from other analysis perspectives.

They are able to assess the framework conditions and structures of the professional field of action, as well as the current and prospective living and working conditions of their addressees, and to take them into account in their professional decisions.
They can evaluate reform approaches related to the vocational education system.
Cooperation and teamwork skills in homework teams and project groups
Exploration of other professional fields (vocational and in-company further education, youth work)
Exploration of operational etiquette and organizational structures
Exploration of economic and/or vocational pedagogical objectives in the practical context

syllabus_topics: Vocational education research (fundamental questions, analysis perspectives and methods)
Work, profession, professionalism, forms of profession
Institutions and organizations of the vocational education system from historical and current perspectives
Structure of the vocational education system and its intertwining with the general education system
Historical, systematic, and exemplary aspects of vocational education and vocational competence development against the background of current challenges
assessment_rules: The module examination can be a project presentation with a colloquium (approx. 15 minutes), a term paper/project work (20-25 pages), or an oral examination (20-30 minutes). The specific form and duration will be announced by the lecturer within the first three weeks of the lecture period. The allocation of credit points occurs if the module final examination is passed. Qualified participation in the courses is a prerequisite for taking exams.
